description: This PHP class `HeaderData` is part of a reporting module within a Human Resource Management system. It manages header-related data such as columns, group counts, and grouped column counts for reports.

classes.name: HeaderData
classes.description: Class for managing header information such as columns and group counts for reports in the HRM system.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Retrieves the list of column objects (either StackedColumn or Column) associated with the header.

methods.name: setColumns
methods.description: Sets the array of column objects for the header.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of columns.

methods.name: setColumnCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of columns.

methods.name: incrementColumnCount
methods.description: Increments the column count by a specified value, default is 1.

methods.name: incrementGroupCount
methods.description: Increments the group count by a specified value, default is 1.

methods.name: getGroupedColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the count of grouped columns.

methods.name: setGroupedColumnCount
methods.description: Sets the number of grouped columns.

methods.name: incrementGroupedColumnCount
methods.description: Increments the grouped column count by a specified value, default is 1.
